name: Sayat-Nova
contribution: An Armenian poet, musician and ashugh, who had compositions in a number of languages.

checks.lead: Sayat-Nova, born Harutyun Sayatyan (Armenian: Հարություն Սայաթյան); 14 June 1712 – 22 September 1795) was an Armenian poet, musician and ashugh, who had compositions in a number of languages.
